Download buttons for the desktop apps, the container, the Android app and the browser extension, and a published image behind the Docker one.

## ✨ Added

- **Download buttons at the top of the README**, in two rows: Windows, macOS and Linux, then Docker, the Android app and the browser extension. Each one leads to the newest build, so none of them needs changing after a release.
- **A container image of KnightLoader itself**, `ghcr.io/junkerderprovinz/knightloader`, for amd64 and arm64. From this release on, every release publishes it beside the relay image.
- **The desktop zips also come without the version in their name**, because a link to the newest release only works with a name that stays the same. `checksums.txt` lists both names.

## ⚡ Improved

- **The newest app and the newest extension each have a standing release**, `mobile/latest` and `extension/latest`, holding the file under a name that does not change. Every new app or extension release refreshes it.
- **`latest` on both images moves only after the build**, and only if no newer release tag turned up in the meantime. An older build that finishes last can no longer pull it back.
